alibabacloud-lingjun-cluster-scaling 0.0.1-beta.3

- Initial beta update for managing Alibaba Cloud Lingjun cluster scaling tasks: extend/shrink clusters, create/update/move node groups.
- Strict trigger/action routing, Bash environment setup, i18n, and multi-stage confirmation rules added.
- All interactions run through validated schema-based, form-first workflows; hand-crafted forms and parameter inference are strictly forbidden.
- Enhanced compliance with business-language-only responses and no system/technical leakage.
- Fast-path commands for expanding and shrinking clusters based on user intent and input structure.
